mapper.select: select a.Y_M as yM,a.REGION as region,a.ORG_ID as orgId,a.ORG_NAME as orgName, sum(a.GZ_YF_NUM) as gzYfNum, sum(a.GZ_SF_NUM) as gzSfNum, sum(a.YF_GZ_TOTAL) as yfGzTotal, sum(a.GZ_TAX_TOTAL) as gzTaxTotal, sum(a.SF_GZ_TOTAL) as sfGzTotal, sum(a.JJ_YF_NUM) as jjYfNum, sum(a.JJ_SF_NUM) as jjSfNum, sum(a.YF_JJ_TOTAL) as yfJjTotal, sum(a.JJ_TAX_TOTAL) as jjTaxTotal, sum(a.SF_JJ_TOTAL) as sfJjTotal from SUB_GZ a ${ew.customSqlSegment} group by a.Y_M,a.REGION,a.ORG_ID,a.ORG_NAME
select a.REGION as region,a.ORG_ID as orgId,a.ORG_NAME as orgName,a.Y_M as flwYM, b.* from SUB_GZ a join SUB_GZ_ITEM b on a.ID = b.SUB_GZ_ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
